Title: Azure Private Link for Azure Monitor is now available

Body.Content:
Azure Private Link is now available for Azure Monitor, including these capabilities:

  • Private connectivity to Azure Monitor Logs workspaces and Azure Application Insights.
  • Data exfiltration protection with granular access to specific resources.
  • Resource protection from public network access.

At this time, you must request access to use Private Link. Apply for access.

Learn more about how to use Private Link for Azure Monitor.

Get started with quickstarts and tutorials for the Azure portal, PowerShell, and Azure CLI.

Learn more about connecting to a Private Link resource through a private endpoint.
